Cohesive 2D side-view 'clockwork pastel' look: 32x32 tile grid, flat-shaded shapes with 1-pixel dark outline, limited palette of deep indigo background (#1B1E3A), warm amber accents (#F2B441), cool cyan for player and interactables (#4FC3D9), and muted violet for ghost silhouettes (#9B7BFF at 55% alpha). Ghosts read as translucent silhouettes, never as a recolor of the player's exact body. All raster assets use nearest filtering and integer scaling (1x native, 2x/4x for display) to keep pixel edges crisp at the fixed 1280x720 viewport. Interactive state changes are expressed by swapping to the 'on'/'active' frame and adding a short tint pulse; no per-state art is generated beyond the two-frame cells below. Font: Godot built-in default font is used because no library font pack is available in this environment; do not bake text into any sprite.
